breaking.member: file.icons / og cook / default UI iconSet
breaking.change: Icons consume checked TS declarations directly; the OGT icons parser and grammar are deleted. SVG paths are canonical relative to the owning module, without source-relative fallback. Exact SVG bytes are captured before cook cache lookup. Native glyph baking, tone runs, sticker and atlas layout are unchanged. The shared built-in iconSet is now @styles/shared/icons/game.ts, evaluated by the same closed TS evaluator.
breaking.fix: Export file.icons({source:'assets/icons',icons:[['close','xmark']]}) from content/icons/ui.ts and load base/icons/ui as a font. source defaults to assets/icons; names are unique single lines and SVG stems stay beneath source. Replace references to @styles/shared/icons/game.ogt with @styles/shared/icons/game.ts. See og api show file:icons.
